_comment: Transition rules jira-workflow-apply.sh --rules ensures are present.
Additive only: a rule already on the transition (same ruleKey + parameters) is left alone,
a missing one is appended, nothing is ever removed.
Transitions are matched by NAME; the stage transitions are GLOBAL, so a rule fires from any status.
Parameter values may name a field or status instead of a site id:
{field:<name>}  -> the custom field id, resolved via GET /field
{status:<name>} -> the status id, resolved via GET /statuses/search
Field, status and transition names are matched exactly (case-sensitive); a mistyped placeholder dies.

parameters.errorMessage: verify is required before work starts
touches is required before work starts
